eas_text: A civil authority has issued A CIVIL EMERGENCY MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Jackson, OR; at 4:56 PM on AUG 13, 2026 Effective until 8:56 PM. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: Wildfire Alert - Jackson County Sheriff's Office has issued a Level 1 BE READY to evacuate for JAC-044 near E Evans Creek rd north of Pine st south of Manzanita dr due to I5 Mile Marker 51 fire. Monitor local news sources for evacuation and incident information.
